goal_excerpt.note: The operator's goal used this heading with eight numbered items. mission_contract._HEADINGS['acceptance'] only exact-matches ('acceptance criteria', 'completion criteria', 'critères d'acceptation'); 'mandatory acceptance criteria' never matches, so build_mission_contract() never sets section='acceptance' for these lines and they are silently dropped (not even routed to mandatory_requirements). explicit_acceptance_criteria ends up empty and derive_acceptance_criteria_from_goal's generic 8-criterion template (required_files, index_assets, index_game_ui, style_non_empty, game_controls, game_collectible_score, game_restart, local_usage) is silently substituted as the verification contract instead.

run_identity_projection_observed.note: control_surface.py's _run_identity() never includes a backend field at all; the Run Identity panel's renderRunIdentity() in control_surface.html independently derives a backend label from state.high_autonomy.backend_id and state.control.backends -- but the server response never sets top-level keys named high_autonomy or control (session_dict()/state_view() only ever sets high_autonomy_summary and agent_backend_control). Both lookups are therefore always undefined, so the panel always falls back to the em dash placeholder regardless of which backend actually governed the run.
